replies.body:
Hey there...


I enjoy the fact that you admit to hacking, but I think we both know hacking is not allowed on this server. And will not be tolerated. Please appeal in 6-8 months and your chances will hopefully improve. I can not give you back your money for your rank, you will have to wait out your punishment. Further more..


This appeal is denied!

Regards,  Mqderator/Josh
